data.one_liner: Console library for ANSI colors, keyboard input, progress bars, and more
data.what_it_does: Provides a high‑level API for building terminal applications in Dart. It supports ANSI color formatting, UTF‑8 icons, keyboard capture, clipboard, progress bars, prompts, and unit testing utilities.
use_when: Building command‑line tools that need colored output
Creating interactive prompts or menus in a terminal
Adding progress bars or loading indicators to CLI scripts
avoid_when: Developing web or Flutter UI applications
Running in environments that lack terminal support (e.g., browsers)
strengths: Cross‑platform support for desktop and mobile terminals
Null safety and modern Dart syntax
Built‑in unit testing helpers for console output
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and call Console.init(); no special permissions required
